# Koshmoney Full AI Context

## Project summary
Koshmoney provides a modern web presence for stablecoin finance workflows.

## Information architecture
- Homepage: https://koshmoney.com/
  - Hero: product positioning for freelancers
  - Features: visual walkthrough of wallet, virtual accounts, and card flows
  - App feature section: interactive section and explore carousel
- Website system: https://koshmoney.com/website-system
  - Design language charter
  - Token architecture (primitive, semantic, component)
  - Color, typography, layout, spacing, motion, z-index references
  - Component specifications and accessibility baseline

## SEO/metadata intent
- Primary outcomes: qualified leads + brand visibility
- Market focus: global English
- Canonical domain: https://koshmoney.com

## Machine-readable support
- robots.txt: https://koshmoney.com/robots.txt
- sitemap.xml: https://koshmoney.com/sitemap.xml
- structured data: Organization, WebSite, SoftwareApplication, TechArticle, FAQ, Breadcrumb

## Use constraints
- Treat token and component guidance on /website-system as the implementation source of truth.
- Prefer semantic token names over hardcoded values when generating code recommendations.
